verdict.rationale: Drata documents workflow automation with "custom triggers and actions" and an API and MCP server for automating compliance tasks. None of the evidence shows a user scheduling a job or workflow on a recurring basis (cron, interval or calendar). Event triggers and automated evidence collection are an adjacent feature, not a user-defined recurring schedule, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
